The state age-adjusted poisoning death rate ranged from 4.6 to 19.4 per 100,000 population.
Nine of ten poisoning deaths were caused by drugs, 7% by inhalation of gases and vapors
Poisoning deaths included deaths classified as unintentional (69%), suicides (19%)
States with the highest rates included West Virginia (19.4), New Mexico (18.4), Utah (17.7), and Nevada (17.3).
SOURCE: CDC. CDC Wonder. Compressed mortality file, 2004.
